title: MASTERS ATTP 2026 – a duel of Moldova’s table tennis masters
excerpt: On 14 March 2026 the TOP CUP Academy arena hosted the third MASTERS ATTP, a tournament reserved for the 18 strongest players of the moment.
body_html:
Table tennis in the Republic of Moldova is getting ready for one of the most spectacular events of the season. On 14 March 2026, the TOP CUP Academy arena in Chișinău will host the third edition of the elite MASTERS ATTP tournament, a competition reserved exclusively for the strongest players of the moment.

This year the TOP 18 masters of Moldovan table tennis will meet in a high-level contest for the Grand Prize and the coveted MASTERS Cup, a symbol of sporting supremacy in a tournament that has already become a fixture of the ATTP calendar.

The tournament will be played in a round-robin format, which means every player will face a series of head-to-head matches against the opponents in their group, each one a real test of strategy, technical precision and mental resilience.

As in the two previous editions, the competition promises heated duels between experienced players and established stars of Moldovan table tennis. In a format like this there are no easy matches, and every point can change the standings and the fate of the trophy.

MASTERS ATTP is designed as a platform for sporting excellence, where performance, fair play and competitive spirit define an athlete’s true worth. The tournament brings together the best players of the moment and creates a high-level show for table tennis fans.

For the participants, the tournament is the ultimate test of character and skill, in which only those who can combine mental balance with technical resilience can aspire to be “the best of the best”.

On 14 March in Chișinău, the stage of Moldovan table tennis will belong to the masters — and the MASTERS Cup will find a new champion.
